entries.description: Curated facts about Dibbur (דיבור), the free open-source Hebrew and Arabic dictation app for macOS: what it is, download links, install steps, permissions and FAQ. The homepage also has a Markdown copy at /index.md (link rel=alternate type=text/markdown).
